requirements: Two independent reviewer labels, adjudication and separate semantic citation review
Repository-family-disjoint training, validation and final test; record every tuning source before freezing
At least 200 reviewed real-change cases with exact base/head revisions and at least two consistency classes
Freeze dataset and pipeline fingerprints before running final test predictions
Bind every prediction to pipeline, repository and base/head revisions
Traceability precision, recall and F1 each >= 0.95
Impact precision, recall and F1 each >= 0.95
Missing, invalid and abstained decisions stay in the denominator
No inference that observed scores establish a population lower bound
Report engineering tests and test-file retrieval separately from assurance correctness
